description: Unmodified Google Fonts Latin WOFF2 assets self-hosted for the synthetic design preview. No runtime Google Fonts requests.
provenanceNote: CDN binaries are pinned by their immutable-looking versioned URLs and exact SHA-256 digests. The repository revision pins license text, metadata, and descriptions; it is not a claim that CDN subset bytes equal repository TTF bytes.
limitations: Normal style only: Noto Serif is bundled at Light 300; all other families are bundled at Regular 400. No bold or italic font files are bundled.
Only Google Fonts Latin subsets are bundled. Other scripts and unsupported glyphs fall back to the configured system font.
These are digital typefaces; the historical labels do not claim facsimile reproduction of Renaissance block printing.
The new calligraphic and display options are modern digital designs or documented revivals, not Renaissance facsimiles.

fonts.label: Renaissance Roman
fonts.description: Revival of Claude Garamont’s mid-sixteenth-century roman types, informed by the 1592 Egenolff–Berner specimen.
